description: Contact-center agent directory (MX, CO, AR), one row per agent. Typed, normalized and checked from workspace.bronze.service_agents. Contains personal data (names, e-mail, phone): mask outside Silver.

load.notes: Single CSV snapshot re-delivered in full. Reads workspace.bronze.branches (full table) to validate assigned_branch_id.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier (AGT-XXXXXXXXXX), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key; referenced by interactions, transcripts, surveys and complaints.

employee_code.description: HR employee code (E + 5 digits). Not unique: 13 codes are shared by 26 agents (see employee_code_collision); never key on it.

employee_code_collision.description: FLAG: employee_code is shared with another agent in the whole directory.

email.description: PII. Agent e-mail, lower-cased. Not unique (12 addresses are shared by 24 agents).

phone.description: PII. Agent phone in international format. Mexican agents carry +54 (see check phone_prefix_matches_country).

native_accent.description: Agent's native accent, lower-cased (same vocabulary as customers.detected_accent).

country_of_origin.description: Canonical country name without accents (delivered values are already canonical).

assigned_branch_id.description: QUARANTINE: assigned branch, only when it exists in the branch directory; NULL otherwise (831 of 833 delivered values are orphans; 367 agents have none).

assigned_branch_id_raw.description: Assigned branch identifier as delivered (trimmed, upper-cased), orphan or not.

assigned_branch_orphan.description: True when assigned_branch_id_raw is present but matches no branch (the value was nulled).

languages.description: Spoken languages as delivered (comma list in Spanish, e.g. 'español, portugués').

language_codes.description: Spoken languages as ISO 639-1 codes (es, en, pt), parsed from languages.

speaks_portuguese.description: True when the agent speaks Portuguese (129 agents): candidate pool for a future Portuguese handoff (no routing uses it yet).

specialty.description: Specialty as delivered (Spanish), canonical casing and accents. NULL for 40% of agents (no specialty recorded).

specialty_en.description: Canonical English specialty; a future handoff could route disputes to 'Complaints and Claims' or 'Fraud' (today handoffs go to queues, not to agents).

avg_csat.description: Agent's average CSAT as delivered, on a 1-5 scale (3.5-5.0) that does not match the 1-4 CSAT of satisfaction_surveys. Descriptive only; never an outcome or label.

total_monthly_interactions.description: Declared monthly interactions (100-800, average 453) against about 17 realized per month in call_center_interactions, which looks like a sample. Descriptive only.

checks.name: employee_code_format
checks.description: Employee code follows the E99999 pattern.

checks.name: employee_code_unique
checks.description: Employee code is not shared with another agent.

checks.name: assigned_branch_found
checks.description: Raw assigned branch exists in the branch directory; failures were nulled.

checks.name: phone_prefix_matches_country
checks.expr: phone IS NULL OR phone LIKE CASE country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN '+52 %' WHEN 'CO' THEN '+57 %' WHEN 'AR' THEN '+54 %' END
checks.description: Dialing prefix matches the agent's country (Mexican agents carry +54).

checks.name: accent_matches_country
checks.expr: native_accent = CASE country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN 'mexican' WHEN 'CO' THEN 'colombian' WHEN 'AR' THEN 'argentine' END
checks.description: Native accent agrees with the country of origin.

checks.name: languages_parsed
checks.expr: size(language_codes) > 0 AND forall(language_codes, x -> x IN ('es', 'en', 'pt'))
checks.description: Every listed language maps to a known ISO code.

checks.name: speaks_spanish
checks.description: The agent speaks Spanish (every contact in the data is Spanish).
